knowledge:
- key_parameters: batch_size=25L ;; controls memory consumption during incremental PCA by specifying the size of data chunks processed at one time. ;; obj=ipc ;; passes the existing PCA state/object to skPartialPCA_step for iterative updates. ;; convert=FALSE ;; used in reticulate::import to prevent automatic conversion of Python objects to R, allowing direct handling by Python functions. ;; delay_load=TRUE ;; delays loading of Python modules until they are explicitly called.
- alternatives: prcomp ;; R's native principal components analysis, which is preferred for standard in-memory datasets where Python/reticulate overhead is unnecessary.
- when_to_use: Use when performing dimensionality reduction (PCA) on very large, out-of-memory datasets that require incremental chunking, or when wanting to leverage scikit-learn's machine learning algorithms directly within a Bioconductor-compatible workflow.
- pitfalls: Running skIncrPCA without proper basilisk cover can be problematic and fail due to environment/dependency issues; manual incremental PCA requires careful tracking of the state object (obj) across steps; automatic conversion of numpy arrays to R objects can cause overhead, so convert=FALSE is recommended for direct python handling.

workflows.name: standard_pca
workflows.intent: Perform standard principal component analysis on an in-memory data matrix using scikit-learn.
input: data.matrix (numeric matrix of features and samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Run PCA using skPCA ;; 2. Extract transformed coordinates using getTransformed.
workflows.code:
ppca = skPCA ( data.matrix (iris[, 1 : 4 ]))
tx = getTransformed (ppca)
dim (tx)
head (tx)

workflows.name: incremental_pca
workflows.intent: Perform memory-bounded incremental principal component analysis on large datasets.
input: irismat (numpy array or matrix representation of data)
workflows.stages: 1. Run incremental PCA with a specified batch size using skIncrPCA ;; 2. Extract transformed coordinates using getTransformed.
workflows.code:
ippcab = skIncrPCA (irismat, batch_size= 25L)
round ( cor ( getTransformed (ippcab), fullpc), 3 )

workflows.name: manual_incremental_pca
workflows.intent: Perform manual incremental PCA step-by-step on data chunks or streams.
input: irismat (numpy array or matrix representation of data)
workflows.stages: 1. Define slicer utility ;; 2. Initialize and update PCA state iteratively using skPartialPCA_step ;; 3. Transform a subset of data using the final PCA object.
workflows.code:
ta = np $ take
ipc = skPartialPCA_step ( ta (irismat, 0 : 49 ,0L))
ipc = skPartialPCA_step ( ta (irismat, 50 : 99 ,0L), obj= ipc)
ipc = skPartialPCA_step ( ta (irismat, 100 : 149 ,0L), obj= ipc)
ipc $ transform ( ta (irismat, 0 : 5 ,0L))
